Full-screen page editor
Page 1

Page tools

This large preview is designed for precise page-level editing.

Signature

All signature editing happens inside this full-screen page: upload/draw, background colour or transparency, light-background removal, crop, rotate, resize, opacity, brightness and contrast. Then drag the signature to the exact location and place it.

Text editing

PDFNova's full text replacement editor is designed for both normal and scanned PDFs. Digital PDFs can use the existing text layer; scanned pages require OCR/layout reconstruction in the secure backend before the original text can be replaced while preserving formatting.
UI ready. Actual existing-text replacement for scanned PDFs requires the OCR/edit backend.

Watermark / background

Watermark/background changes can be previewed in this page editor. Permanent multi-page text/background editing will use the processing engine.
